I've been using their services for almost a year now, and first and foremost, their reliability is unquestionable.

They inform me of even minor changes in my child's health and give me advice on things like whether or not to take them to the hospital, which is incredibly helpful.

Furthermore, they hold seasonal events, and my child looks forward to going to kindergarten; they even get excited when we're near it.

We've completed a 20-session course since August.

Thank you so much for everything.

My dog ​​was born in March, so by the time he finished his vaccinations, it was extremely hot, and we weren't making much progress with walk practice, so we decided to enroll him in the kindergarten. During our initial discussions, many things made sense, and after a trial session, we decided to send him twice a week.

He's a timid dog, so at first he wouldn't eat treats, and I was worried about many things, but he loves playing with other dogs, and as he enjoyed going, he became comfortable walking outside. I was so moved to see him playing with other dogs! 😊
Now, he gets so excited when we start getting ready to go to kindergarten. They train him at his own pace, so I think we'll continue sending him for a while longer.

I also enjoy the daily videos! 😊

I was worried about whether she would be able to attend kindergarten because the breeder told me she was a timid type, but now, as soon as she arrives at kindergarten, she happily runs straight to her friends.

I truly felt that choosing Puppy Love was the right decision when I saw her happily playing with her friends. It's difficult to create an environment where she can play with other dogs at home, so this is a valuable opportunity for her to interact with others.

They send us videos of her day, so we can see what she's doing during training, playtime, and walks, which gives us peace of mind.

This is our first time owning a dog, so there's a lot we don't know, but
with the trainer's advice and through her experience at kindergarten, we hope to have a fun time with Mel as a family.

It's been three years since I got a puppy, but I won't be able to spend enough time with him on the days I have to work, so I signed up for counseling to discuss training.
After hearing about it, I decided to enroll him in the nursery, wanting to give him a chance to cherish his time during his formative years, when he's most absorbent.
On his first day at the nursery, when he saw his friends, he was so engrossed in playing that he didn't even follow me, and I felt a little sad, but then I felt relieved that maybe the nursery was right for him.
This is his 10th time at the nursery. I'm looking forward to him gradually becoming more capable, but I also feel a little happy when other owners praise him on our morning and evening walks for being so calm, even though he's just a puppy. I think it's thanks to Puppy Love that he's become so friendly with all the dogs and their owners, and is so well-liked.
Above all, his flexibility in accommodating sudden schedule changes and overnight stays is a great help.
We look forward to your continued support.

We are currently enrolled in your 30-session kindergarten course.

When we first welcomed our 4-month-old daughter, Kokoro, into our home, she would cry sadly when left alone and would go to the bathroom wherever she pleased! We thought maybe it was normal for such a young puppy, but we decided to consult with you anyway.

You provided clear and thorough guidance on understanding a dog's feelings and the necessary mindset for a dog owner.

After attending several sessions, our family was struck by how well-behaved she had become.

You send us videos of her lessons and walks after each session, which our family also looks forward to. We believe that being able to watch her grow day by day is all thanks to Puppy Love and all the staff.

We look forward to continuing our relationship with you.

We are grateful for your dog's daycare services.

At first, our dog was shy around other dogs, but now he seems to enjoy it.

After a break from walks, he was scared and reacted negatively to everything when he resumed walks, but the training he received during walks at daycare has greatly improved his behavior. He's even starting to play with other dogs!

We also enjoy watching the videos you provide of our dog's daycare activities.

We would like to continue using your services for the sake of our dog and our family.

Since this is my first time owning a dog, I decided to enroll him in a daycare center even before bringing him home.

During the initial consultation, I spoke with the trainer and felt that their approach and philosophy towards dogs suited me, so I decided to entrust him to Puppy Love.

Their teaching method, which doesn't force the dogs and focuses on praising them when they do well, will be a valuable asset for the dog's future.

I was happy that they sent me a video summary of his day at daycare each time.

He seems to be learning to communicate with other dogs through playtime, and other dog owners have commented on how calm he is for a puppy during walks.

I still have a lot to learn as a dog owner, but I will continue to use the advice and videos I received from Puppy Love as a reference as I interact with my dog ​​every day.

We enrolled in a 10-session course! This was our first time welcoming a puppy into our home, and we just thought we'd give it a try. But with each session, we felt like our puppy was getting smarter and more sociable, and we're so glad we did. We also appreciated receiving detailed notes and videos of each session, which gave us peace of mind.

I requested in-home potty training shortly after getting my 3-month-old Toy Poodle (Una). With the training methods they taught me, she was able to potty train within a week. The consultation at that time was also very informative. After a trial day at daycare, we enrolled her in a 10-session course. Attending daycare has made her love both people and other dogs. She was originally a timid dog, but now she doesn't bark at other dogs during walks and hardly barks unnecessarily at home. When I pick her up, all the dogs greet her, so I felt it was a daycare where she could feel safe and love both people and other dogs. They also sent me videos of her at daycare, and seeing her having fun playing with other dogs made me so glad I enrolled her. Even after the 10-session course is finished, we will continue to use their services for grooming and boarding.

When I came for a consultation, one of the dogs that had been taken care of was barking constantly, and I was shocked to hear the counsellor banging on the crate to try to quiet it down.
It may be that this is their way of signaling, but I would be sad if I left my own dog there and was treated the same way, so I stopped going.
I was also concerned about their attitude during the trial training...it seemed like we weren't a good match.

We're grateful for your help with our dog's daycare.

We started attending after consulting with you about our dog's nipping and dislike of walks. Since he was past the puppy stage, we wondered if it was too late, but his behavior has calmed down considerably since starting. The YouTube videos were also very helpful.

We all looked forward to the videos you sent each time, showing him in lessons, on walks, and playing with other dogs.

We're so glad we enrolled!

Thank you so much for everything you do at the kindergarten!
